items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: There's another guy said Mule Face.

ctx.x: There's another guy said Mule Face.

The reason I asked you that, Jo, was to get back to Billie Holiday. I have heard and I just want to clear it for the record because I'm sure you were there, that Billie Holiday named Lester Young "Pres" and that he named her "Lady Day". Now do you have any things to say about that?
